about: Hand-written chat situations, labelled with whom the last message is for: the agent or the people. No real user data. {agent} stands for ARMADA_AGENT_NAME. A message is [sender, sender is a bot, text]; new_message is [sender, text]. Used by tools/armada/typesafe_addressing_eval and by zerver/tests/test_armada_typesafe.py. Each message is at most 240 characters, the router's own limit, so the evaluation sends what the server would. The last 14 cases were written after the request to TypeSafe was settled, and run once to check that the result holds on chats it was not tuned on.

cases.label: agent
messages: @**{agent}** why does test_login fail on CI but not locally?
CI runs with TZ=UTC and the fixture builds its dates in local time, so the session expiry lands a day early. Three other tests build dates the same way.
